notes.title: Patch 1.2.0 - Release Notes
notes.content:
[h1][b]Balance & Adjustments[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Added an option to display or hide the HP bar.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890655/641745a7649b1a2fa4f4d8c938d5a653ec39a4a9.png[/img]
[*] Reduced mana consumption rate for smoother gameplay.
[*] Adjusted matching gesture score system for better accuracy.
[*] All shop items now cost 20% less.
[*] Various bug fixes and stability improvements.
[/list]

[h1][b]New Content[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Added new gesture symbols for more dynamic spellcasting.
[*][b] New Spell: Cyclone Surge[/b] – Unleash a swirling vortex of magic to devastate enemies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890655/8b9587c768dceb8dd9094d11e9cdc718fdc0b2c4.png[/img]

[*] New Boss: Inferna – Face the fiery wrath of the new boss in the arena of flames!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890655/0bc6c9d215ebde3c6368b7c105bfeb5f747ccf31.png[/img]


[*] Boss Leaderboard: Compete with others and rise to the top by defeating bosses as quickly and efficiently as possible!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890655/a6699073f8c27545088f6946447d3361fa29ce78.jpg[/img]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890655/f1140a7d3d361a7248d6cd979393481267e3aa39.gif[/img]

notes.title: Updated 1.1.1
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed red indicator still appearing after a monster's death.
[*] Fixed Healing spell ability UI showing the wrong indicator.
[/list]

[b]Balancing:[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed Z and Triangle gestures for smoother gameplay.
[*] ArrowWraith: Increased cooldown before attacking.
[*] Adjusted mana consumption rate.
[*] Adjusted monster spawn rate in campaign mode.
[/list]

[b]Contents:[/b]
Currently, over 50 players compete on the leaderboard, all striving to climb to the top. Join us in the Leaderboard Challenge!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890655/8e30e0031ecfacd962d0f7df758db77b16da6e30.png[/img]

[b]Next Update:[/b]
Stay tuned for new bosses with super challenges.

[b]PS: Tomorrow, Magic Caster is 30% off![/b]

notes.title: Magic Caster is available!
notes.content:
[b]Hey Magic Casters![/b]

I’m incredibly excited to announce the official release of [b]Magic Caster![/b] The time has come, and I think this is the perfect moment to publish my first game. It's been over a year since I started working on this project, and I can’t believe it’s finally complete. Although I’m a solo developer, I’ve had the support and advice of some amazing friends and fellow game developers. It's a tear in my eye.

[b]Features and Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] 4 bosses to defeat
[*] 10 levels of campaign mode
[*] 1 Endless mode with leaderboard
[*] 10+ achievements to unlock
[*] More spells, pets, and wands to discover
[*] Face a variety of monsters (they’re out to get you!)
[/list]

[b]Ongoing Development and Support:[/b]
I want to assure you that my journey doesn't stop here, even if you’ve already bought the game. I’m dedicated to continuously improving the game, adding more content, and fixing any issues based on your feedback.

[b]Join the Magic Caster Community:[/b]
[list]
[*] [url=https://discord.gg/xZx7MBBVNd]Discord[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@lavalittlebird?is_from_webapp=1&sender_device=pc]TikTok[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCHKIg_Ozgi4B2P5eEix9-YQ]Youtube[/url]
[*] [url=https://x.com/lavalittleBird]X(Twitter)[/url]
[/list]

Thank you for being a part of my first game and my journey. Get ready to embark on the magical adventure of a lifetime with [b]Magic Caster![/b] Have fun!

Thank you so much, Teerawat Samansook - LavaLittleBird
